lines.zh: 髓骨虫巢里，我的壳最硬。
lines.en: In the bone nest, my shell is the hardest.
Bone joint by joint grinds over gravel.
Its shell scrapes the burrow wall as it crawls.
Six legs move as one, kicking up rot-dust.
It climbs the heap of bones.

lines.zh: 触角探过碎石，身子才跟。
lines.en: Antennae feel past the gravel, then the body follows.
It skirts a pit in the burial ground.

lines.zh: 我把触角插进腐土里翻找。
lines.en: I push my antennae into the rotting soil to search.

lines.zh: 我的骨甲在巢里蹭得发亮。
lines.en: My bone armor has been polished smooth in the nest.
It scrapes rotten earth onto its back.
Its antennae trace slow circles in the air.

lines.zh: 我用触角量你，从头到脚。
lines.en: My antennae measure you from head to toe.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里长出的眼睛，找到你了。
lines.en: The eye grown in my bones has found you.

lines.zh: 我骨缝里的眼睛全朝你转。
lines.en: Every eye in my bone seams turns toward you.

lines.zh: 我把你当成一具会走路的尸骨。
lines.en: I take you for a corpse that can still walk.

lines.zh: 它把你当成一具待腐的尸骨。
lines.en: It takes you for a corpse not yet rotted.

lines.zh: 听到腐肉香味，你难以抗拒。
lines.en: You can't resist the smell of decay.

lines.zh: 腐烂的尸骨，它梦寐以求。
腐肉的香气吸引它而来。
lines.en: It's drawn by the smell of decay.
Its future lies in the decay.

lines.zh: 腐肉中的养分使它强壮。
lines.en: Nutrients in decay make it strong.
This pile of bones is still warm. Perfect.

lines.zh: 硬壳撞向你，你感到剧痛。
lines.en: Its hard shell strikes you, causing pain.

lines.zh: 触角缠绕，让你无法挣脱。
坚硬的外壳撞击你，你踉跄后退。
lines.en: Its hard shell hits you, sending you staggering.

lines.zh: 触须缠绕，使你动弹不得。
坚硬的壳撞击，你踉跄倒地。
lines.en: Its hard shell hits you, sending you sprawling.
Its shell hits you, causing pain.

lines.zh: 坚硬的外壳撞向你，你踉跄。
lines.en: Its hard shell hits you, sending you staggering.

lines.zh: 坚硬的壳撞击，你感到剧痛。
lines.en: Its hard shell hits you, causing pain.
Its shell hits you, sending you staggering.

lines.zh: 坚硬的外壳撞击，你踉跄倒地。
lines.en: Its hard shell hits you, sending you sprawling.

lines.zh: 我用触角敲了敲雌虫的壳。
lines.en: I tap my antennae against a female's shell.
Its tentacles search for a mate.
Its tentacles search for a mate.

lines.zh: 触须缠绕，它找到了伴侣。
lines.en: Its tentacles bind, finding a mate.

lines.zh: 触角缠绕，它开始了求偶。
lines.en: Its tentacles bind, beginning the mating dance.

lines.zh: 触角缠绕，它找到了配偶。
lines.en: Its tentacles bind, finding a mate.

lines.zh: 触须缠绕，它开始了求偶。
lines.en: Its tentacles bind, beginning the mating dance.

lines.zh: 它敲击甲壳，呼唤同巢的雌虫。
lines.en: It taps its shell, calling a female from the nest.

lines.zh: 这具蜕壳，是我的战利品。
lines.en: This shed shell is my trophy.

lines.zh: 腐土中的猎物，给我尝尝！
lines.en: Prey from the rotten earth, taste it!

lines.zh: 这里的食物不够了，找点别的！
巢穴的腐化之力增强我！
lines.en: The corruption of the nest strengthens me!
Corrupted maggots, get out of the way!

lines.zh: 寻找新的食物源，生存下去！
腐土中的生命，我要吞噬！
lines.en: Life in the rotten earth, I will consume you!

lines.zh: 巢穴的守护者，是我的盟友！
lines.en: The nest guardians are my allies!

lines.zh: 这里太安全了，我要出去！
lines.en: Too safe here, I need to venture out!
The power of corruption makes me stronger!
Young one near, prepare to devour!

lines.zh: 巢穴中的生物，是我的猎物！
lines.en: Creatures of the nest, my prey!
Corrupted spirits, I will consume you!

lines.zh: 腐化的味道，指引我的猎物！
lines.en: The smell of corruption, guides my prey!

lines.zh: 巢穴的出口，我的下一个目标！
lines.en: The nest exit, my next target!
The stench of corruption, my prey!

lines.zh: 巢穴深处，我的下一个目标！
lines.en: Deeper into the nest, my next target!

lines.zh: 巢穴的中心，我的下一个目标！
lines.en: The nest's heart, my next target!

lines.zh: 你踩碎的骨头惊动了它。
lines.en: The bone you crushed alerted it.
The smell of the burial ground has changed.

lines.zh: 毒腺鼓起来，黏液滴在骨头上。
lines.en: My venom gland swells; slime drips onto the bone.
The agony of corruption, upon the prey!
The power of corruption, consumes all!

lines.zh: 猎物颤抖，腐化将你吞噬！
我的毒液，让你腐烂四秒！
lines.en: My venom, causes 4 seconds of corruption!

lines.zh: 口器一张一合，滴下黏液。

lines.en: It drops low and circles from the side.

lines.zh: 骨足扣住地面，准备弹起。
lines.en: Bone legs grip the ground to spring.

lines.zh: 毒液注进去，腐烂会跟四秒。
lines.en: Venom injected; the rot lasts four seconds.

lines.zh: 毒刺从你护甲缝里扎进去。
lines.en: My stinger drives through a seam in your armor.
My joints scrape the nest wall all the way.

lines.zh: 骨巢里的腐气，先我一步出来。
lines.en: The rot smell left the nest before I did.
The bone waste's soil is pushed open.
An adult crawls out of a burial pit.

lines.zh: 火烤得我的骨甲噼啪裂开。
lines.en: The fire cracks my bone armor with a pop.
The arrowhead is stuck in my bone seam.
